mostWorthwhile.text: Separating the chromosome sets was most worthwhile: the explanation distinguishes sister-chromatid separation from division of the shared cytoplasm.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making membrane vesicles was less satisfying because the result did not explain their role until the subsequent cell-growth step.

surprise.text: The genome-copying explanation clarified that replication includes noncoding DNA and is distinct from making proteins.

arbitrary.text: The vesicle construction felt somewhat arbitrary at first: phospholipids and proteins plausibly form membranes, but their connection to cell growth was not yet explained.

continue.text: I would continue to see how cells with the same genome develop different structures, although the later sequence of only-available combinations offered few meaningful choices.
